title: Metric sculpture
summary: A 21.6 s narrated launch film that proves one real growth number: the product's own app redrawn as a living screencast where a pixel mascot acts out the work (result, rewind, the request, a 60-day time-lapse), then one whip into a 3D studio where the number is built from falling plates, a hit on the verdict and the logo lockup.

optional.FAL_KEY (ElevenLabs via fal): new voice lines (tools/voice.py) and new music (tools/music.md)

craft: the result is the first sentence and the first picture
the proof shown twice: as work, then as countable quantity
numbers count by plates landed, never by time
the feed accelerates; toks get closer, the mallet climbs every tenth plate
a beat of silence at 14.7, one hit at 15.0

style.ground: app on a dark green desktop, then a warm sweep studio (#d8d0c3)
style.type: the app's own fonts in the screencast; Inter 300 numbers, Geist labels, Geist Mono units in the studio
style.accent: one brand accent, only on the verdict and the last line
banned: screenshots pasted in place of the redrawn app
dark void, glow or bloom in the studio
a KPI grid as the hero
style.motion: UI expo.out 0.45 s; camera power2.inOut; mascot squash-and-stretch jumps; plates fall with gravity and quintic landings

generators: ElevenLabs TTS (Brian) via fal, five lines

reference.name: Our own 'Votrix AI 100×' film (2026-10-30); grammar from lemo-opuscar's Living Screencast and Data Physicalization styles

from_product: one true metric with a before, an after and a period, and its source
the real app (screenshots or a demo account) to redraw 1:1: labels, layout, colours
agent or feature names, roles and portraits (2-5)
one line of what it does and a call to action
generated: one 21 s music track with the hit at 15.0 (tools/music.md)

fits: a growth result: views, signups, revenue, leads, saved hours
AI agents or assistants that did the work from one request
case-study posts and 'we did X in N days' launches on X, LinkedIn, YouTube
avoid: no real number, or one that cannot be sourced
ratios above 150x at one plate size, or a before of more than 5 plates
products with no app to show
combines_with: launch/feature-roster (the roster before, this as the proof)
